name: text-highlighter
title: Text Highlighter
description: Marked phrases in a paragraph get a highlighter fill that wipes across them (left to right, right to left, top down or bottom up), one phrase after another, wrapping correctly across lines.
useWhen: Key phrases inside a paragraph should be picked out with a highlighter wipe, in reading order.
The highlights may break over several lines and each line should fill as the wipe runs.
avoidWhen: Only a single word needs a marker stroke: use marker-highlight.
The emphasis is a colour change, not a fill: use inline-highlight.
author: Daniel Petho
